question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

Hardly had the results been announced (1)/ when the crowd begins (2)/ to celebrate loudly (3)/ outside the hall. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect tense of the verb "begin" in part 2.
 
• The past perfect tense in the first part of the sentence ("Hardly had the results been announced") requires the simple past tense in the following part ("began").
 
• The correct phrase should be "the crowd began to celebrate loudly," ensuring grammatical consistency.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Hardly had the results been announced when the crowd began to celebrate loudly outside the hall."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **(1): "Hardly had the results been announced" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **(3): "to celebrate loudly" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **(4): "outside the hall." **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
